caption: COLLINS, PATRICK J., ET AL. V. MNUCHIN, SEC. OF TREASURY, ET AL.
text: Aaron Nielson, Esquire, of Provo, Utah, is invited to brief and argue, as amicus curiae, in support of the position that the structure of the Federal Housing Finance Agency does not violate the separation of powers.
